article.story: HAMMOND, La. -- — Makhi Myles scored 20 points as Southeastern Louisiana beat Incarnate Word 74-62 on Monday night. Myles shot 7 for 9 (3 for 4 from 3-point range) and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line for the Lions (8-17, 5-11 Southland Conference). Jaiden Lawrence scored 17 on 6-for-10 shooting. The Cardinals (10-15, 5-11) were led by Davion Bailey, who recorded 20 points and three steals. Jordan Pyke added 13 points and Tahj Staveskie scored nine. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
